take: Buffalo announced it has activated goalie Alex Lyon from injured reserve and placed forward Konsta Helenius on injured reserve. Helenius, a third-line forward, has one goal and three points in 11 games. The Sabres have been 0.87 percentage points better in share of expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. In the five games since he went out, Jason Zucker has taken his spot beside Norris and Kulich, Peyton Krebs is up to 15:50 a night from 11:59, and Sam Carrick is up to 8:46 from 5:46.
